title: Write a check that finds a defect

outcomes.can: Explain which boundary test distinguishes a defect from its fix.

intro: A test calls a program with known input and compares its actual result with the expected result. A useful boundary case sits just where a rule changes. Reading the first failed comparison tells you which input to trace. A regression test is a test kept to catch a previously fixed defect.

steps.title: Write a check that finds a defect
steps.text: A test calls a program with known input and compares its actual result with the expected result. A useful boundary case sits just where a rule changes. Reading the first failed comparison tells you which input to trace. A regression test is a test kept to catch a previously fixed defect.

steps.title: Predict before running
steps.text: Read the example and predict what happens before checking your answer.

steps.title: Trace the example
steps.text: The rule is “three or more.” With input 3 the expected result is true, but the candidate returns false. At 4 both the faulty and corrected versions would return true. For a useful regression, run your test on both versions and confirm only the faulty one fails. Passing a candidate function as an argument lets the same test exercise multiple implementations.

steps.title: Check your explanation
steps.text: Read the indicated code and choose the explanation that accounts for its behavior.

steps.title: Repair a threshold
steps.text: Return true for at least limit tasks. Inputs are nonnegative numbers. The failing case has count equal to limit.

steps.title: Test a faulty count
steps.text: Use the contract in the exercise and check your answer on save.

choices.feedback: Four already passes the strict comparison.

questions.prompt: Would testing only four detect the defect?

choices.text: Yes, four is above the limit.
choices.feedback: The defect occurs at the boundary.
An input that produces identical outputs cannot distinguish the versions.

review.evidence: Use a fresh answer on a later visit. An unaided pass on the changed case adds independent evidence. Preserve hint use and solution reveals with their attempts.

drillGap: The linked drills isolate syntax. This module checks the combined behavior on varied inputs.
